{{Top|leg}}
'''Bshrah-Ky-Ushsj''' was a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] who explored [[System VV-99-7JE-2N71]]. He would record his observations on an [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]] [[Astrogation datacard|datacard]], which were later decrypted by [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Jonas Durns|Durns]], [[Keya Durns|his daughter]], [[Sig Coven|his business partner]], and a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]], who were searching for a mythical [[Kragg's Fury|pirate ship]] rumored to be derelict in the VV-99-7JE-2N71 system.
